notes: *smote the hindmost* is read as a light verb plus complement headed on *hindmost*; heading on *smote* was the alternative, rejected because *smote* alone loses the verb's rear-guard lexeme (rules 44, 31).

The circumstantial waw of וְאַתָּה עָיֵף takes the subordinator *when* written for it (rules 14, 55), while the explicit pronoun keeps only *thou* and the copula joins the predicate adjective (rule 20).
